Chlorine Dioxide (CDS/MMS) Protocol

Therapy oxidative-therapy chlorine-dioxide cds-mms parasite antimicrobial

Evidence: opinion

Summary

Chlorine dioxide (CDS - Chlorine Dioxide Solution / MMS - Miracle Mineral Solution) is an oxidative therapy used for antimicrobial support. Protocol A is the standard activation method with citric acid. Supports the body's oxidative immune mechanisms.

Type: oxidative

Benefits

  • Antimicrobial support
  • Parasite elimination
  • Oxidative immune support
  • Pathogen clearance

Contraindications

  • Kidney disease (active phase)
  • Bleeding disorders
  • Chronic low blood pressure
  • Pregnancy and breastfeeding
  • Interaction with blood thinners

Session Duration: Preparation-dependent (Protocol A requires 15-20 min activation)

Frequency Recommendation: Follow established CDS protocols - typically 1-3 activated drops as directed by trained practitioner

Cost Range: $15-40 for initial protocol supplies
